$comment: Every men's standard-T20 competition the Scout Lab scope names, with its source status. 'warehouseCode' links to sources.json / global.db competitions.code. Status is never 'ingested' unless global.db holds verified matches; the coverage report (global:coverage) reads the real counts. Checked 2026-11-17.
formatPolicy: Men's standard T20 only (20 overs a side). Tests, first-class, ODI, List A, The Hundred (100-ball) and T10 are excluded and never aggregated with T20.

competitions.name: Men's T20 Internationals
competitions.source: Cricsheet t20s_male_json (ODC-BY); Cricsheet withholds Afghanistan-related matches

competitions.name: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy
competitions.source: Cricsheet sma_json (ODC-BY). Cricsheet's catalogue (695 matches, checked 2026-11-17) ends at the 2024-25 season; later seasons are not yet published there.
competitions.blocker: Seasons after 2024-25: BCCI publishes scorecards on bcci.tv, which loads them from /api/ — disallowed in bcci.tv/robots.txt — and offers no download or data licence. Not acquired.

competitions.name: Men's U23 State A Trophy (T20)
competitions.blocker: Not on Cricsheet; BCCI domestic scorecards are served from bcci.tv/api/ (robots-disallowed), no permitted bulk access found.

sourceAssessments.cricsheet: Primary source. ODC-BY 1.0 (attribution required). Ball-by-ball JSON; no bowling style, batting hand or nationality.
sourceAssessments.cricmetric: No published API, dataset download or data licence. robots.txt (checked 2026-11-17) disallows /api/ and /jscripts/ (its data endpoints). Aggregates only, so it could never supply ball-by-ball data. No adapter built.
sourceAssessments.bcci: bcci.tv robots.txt disallows /api/, the endpoint its scorecards load from; no download or licence offered. No adapter built.
sourceAssessments.kaggle-github: Not investigated in this pass. Most redistributed T20 datasets derive from Cricsheet, but each would need its licence and provenance checked before use.
